$comment: Seed speech definition (ADR-0028 starter pack, held phonics batch). A shared instruction stem (C21 variant 'instruction', the player's 'Read it to me'; owner decision D-1): the on-screen instruction without the word the child must read. ID by the admin convention instruction-<first words>. Loaded as a DRAFT by scripts/seed_content.py, then previewed, played to the end and approved in the admin app. 'Read' is a heteronym: plain text was spoken as past-tense 'red' (owner, 2026-11-16), so the SSML says it as 'reed' with <sub>.
title: Read the word, then tap its picture.
ssml: <sub alias="reed">Read</sub> the word, then tap its picture.
